name: Real-time sword combat
oneLiner: Top-down real-time melee on the map: a 4- or 8-way sword swing with anticipation, active and recovery frames and a sweeping arc hitbox, a 2-3 hit combo with buffered input, knockback with friction, translucent invulnerability flicker after a hit, enemies built from small reusable state machines (wander, chase, telegraphed charge, keep-distance shooter, a boss that mixes them), contact and projectile damage, hearts, and drops on defeat.
fits: village or overworld quests that need combat on the map
notFor: menu or turn-based battles (use A-01 or A-02)
fighting games with frame-perfect cancels and juggles

needs: the player's feet box {x, y, w, h} in world px (the game keeps walking it; the module moves it only for knockback)
a wall test solid(x, y, w, h) in the same world px
held directions and an attack press per step (edge-latched)
enemy spawn points (id, behaviour, position) from the game's rooms or map
optional: the game's own HP getter/setter, enemy art, a hit-stop gate
provides: hit events: onHit {kind melee|projectile|contact|charge|host, source, target, amount, at, dir, strength, killed, hpBefore, hpAfter} and onDefeat
hit-stop requests onHitStop(ms), or a built-in freeze
anchor(id) sprite boxes for the player and every enemy, uiRects() for the hearts
canMove() / pose() / playerAlpha() so the game's walking and sprite follow the swing and the i-frame flicker
an autopilot that scores moves by danger along the path (projectiles, telegraphed charges, bodies) and fights
drops and pickups (hearts heal, gems count, custom kinds through onPickup)

assets: module/sword-combat.js (global GameDNA_SwordCombat, no dependencies; API in module/README.md). Built-in procedural pixel sprites for five enemy looks (slime, hound, boar, archer, warden), hearts, gems, projectiles, the blade and slash trail. No external files.
